title: Pure tensor and scalar sections of the site comparison adjunction
statement: Let T be a scheme in universe u and A a commutative ring in Type(u+1). Let F and G be the etale to pro-etale comparison inverse and direct image functors on sheaves of A-modules [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and let eta be their adjunction unit. Use the sheafified sectionwise tensor and constant-module units [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor]. For etale U, pro-etale W, f:W→toProEt(U), A-module sheaves M,N on the etale site, and sections x of M(U), y of N(U), applying the oplax tensor map F(M tensor N)→FM tensor FN to the restriction along f of eta_(M tensor N) applied to the pure tensor x tensor y gives the pure tensor of the restrictions of eta_M(x) and eta_N(y). The inverse-image unit map F(1)→1 applied to the restriction of eta_1 of the constant scalar a gives the constant scalar a on W, for every a in A. There are no finiteness, invertibility, nonemptiness or root-lifting assumptions.

proof.text: Apply the Mathlib monoidal-adjunction unit tensor equation unit_app_tensor_comp_map_δ. Precompose by the underlying presheaf pure-tensor map. Its naturality moves the two unit components past this map; the continuous pushforward tensor component equation identifies the result with the pro-etale pure-tensor map on toProEt(U). Evaluate at x tensor y. Naturality of the oplax tensor map and the presheaf pure-tensor map along f proves the displayed equality on W. This uses the existing source-library monoidal structure on the comparison adjunction.

Apply unit_app_unit_comp_map_η and precompose by the underlying presheaf unit map. The continuous pushforward unit component formula identifies the resulting map with the pro-etale constant-scalar sheafification unit on toProEt(U). Evaluate at a and use naturality of both the oplax unit and the constant-presheaf sheafification unit along f.

theorem comparison_pure_sections (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    (∀ (M N : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (U : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (f : W.unop ⟶ (toProEt T).obj U.unop)
    (x : M.obj.obj U) (y : N.obj.obj U),
      (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T)
      M N).hom.app W
        (((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj (M ⊗ N)).obj.map f.op
          (((ProEtale.comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).unit.app
            (M ⊗ N)).hom.app U
              ((Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (sheafToPresheaf T.smallEtaleTopology
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) M N).app U (x ⊗ₜ[A] y)))) =
      (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (sheafToPresheaf (ProEt.topology T) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj M)
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj N)).app W
          ((((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj M).obj.map f.op
            (((ProEtale.comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).unit.app M).hom.app U x))
          ⊗ₜ[A]
          (((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj N).obj.map f.op
            (((ProEtale.comparisonAdjunction
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).unit.app N).hom.app U y)))) ∧
    (∀ (U : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (W : T.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (f : W.unop ⟶ (toProEt T).obj U.unop) (a : A),
      (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T)).hom.app W
      (((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).obj (𝟙_ _)).obj.map f.op
        (((ProEtale.comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) T).unit.app (𝟙_ _)).hom.app U
          ((toSheafify T.smallEtaleTopology
            ((Functor.const T.Etaleᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of.{u + 1, u + 1} A A))).app U a))) =
      (toSheafify (ProEt.topology T)
        ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj (ModuleCat.of.{u + 1, u + 1} A A))).app W a)
